html:
Hayreddin Barbarossa was a corsair and Ottoman admiral who, with his brother Oruç, took Algiers in the 1510s and made it the capital of a state under the Ottoman sultan.

The brothers came from the Aegean island of Lesbos and raided Spanish shipping. Algiers asked for their help against the Spanish, who held a fort off the port. Oruç took the town in 1516 and was killed in 1518. Hayreddin placed Algiers under the sultan, drove out the Spanish fort in 1529, and built the Regency of Algiers.

He went on to command the Ottoman fleet and won the Battle of Preveza in 1538. The state he founded lasted until the French invasion of 1830 and set the outline of modern Algeria. See also the Barbary corsairs.
